env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A loGo/s importer sees an exported map-bearing composite with table reads,
# detached inline copies, and readonly map descendants.
cd m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importcc$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importcc$GOEXE
stdout '^ok read 1$'
stdout '^ok len 3$'
stdout '^ok comma-miss$'
stdout '^ok range a1;b2;c3;$'
stdout '^ok copy-detached 99 7$'
stdout '^ok copy-orig 1$'
stdout '^ok independent 20 30 7$'
stdout '^ok shared-read 1 1$'
stdout '^ok fmt {map\[a:1 b:2 c:3\] 7}$'
stdout '^ok deep$'
! stdout 'FAIL'
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/app/main.go
exists out/lib/lib.go
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
go run ./app
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cp v2lib.lgo lib/lib.lgo
logos build -o $WORK/bin/importcc2$GOEXE ./app
exec $WORK/bin/importcc2$GOEXE
stdout '^ok read 100$'
stdout '^ok range a100;b2;c3;$'
stdout '^ok copy-orig 100$'
stdout '^ok shared-read 100 100$'
! stdout 'FAIL'
cd ..

# A write through an imported composite map, directly or through a copy or alias, is rejected.
cd badmut
! logos build ./...
stderr -count=5 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos eject -o $WORK/badmut-out
stderr -count=5 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ccompmap

go 1.27

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 1, "c": 3}, N: 7}

-- m/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"

	"example.com/ccompmap/lib"
)

var failed bool

func check(name string, cond bool) {
	if !cond {
		failed = true
		fmt.Println("FAIL", name)
	}
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("ok read", lib.C.M["a"] ?? -1)
	fmt.Println("ok len", len(lib.C.M))
	v, ok := lib.C.M["zz"]
	check("comma-miss", !ok && v == 0)
	fmt.Println("ok comma-miss")
	keys := ""
	for k, val := range lib.C.M {
		keys += fmt.Sprintf("%s%d;", k, val)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok range", keys)
	orig := lib.C.M["a"] ?? -1
	c := lib.C
	c.N = 99
	fmt.Println("ok copy-detached", c.N, lib.C.N)
	fmt.Println("ok copy-orig", orig)
	c1 := lib.C
	c2 := lib.C
	c1.N = 20
	c2.N = 30
	fmt.Println("ok independent", c1.N, c2.N, lib.C.N)
	shared := lib.C.M
	again := lib.C
	fmt.Println("ok shared-read", shared["a"] ?? -1, again.M["a"] ?? -1)
	fmt.Println("ok fmt", fmt.Sprint(lib.C))
	check("deep", reflect.DeepEqual(lib.C.M, map[string]int{"a": orig, "b": 2, "c": 3}))
	fmt.Println("ok deep")
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

-- m/v2lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 100, "c": 3}, N: 7}

-- badmut/go.mod --
module example.com/ccompmut

go 1.27

-- badmut/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type S struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const C = S{M: map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 1}, N: 7}

-- badmut/app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ccompmut/lib"
)

func main() {
	lib.C.M["a"] = 9
	c := lib.C
	c.M["a"] = 99
	c1 := lib.C
	c1.M["b"] = 20
	c2 := lib.C
	c2.M["b"] = 30
	shared := lib.C.M
	shared["a"] = 999
	fmt.Println(lib.C.M["a"] ?? -1)
}
